notes: PROBE, NOT THE UNIT'S RED TEST. Scenario 17 is the ONLY one of the 27 that reaches the WE_Mode == 1 call site (clean ControllerBlocks.f90:389, 15,062 hits, 0 in every other scenario), and it did NOT move under the 13th-digit PI perturbation that moved 145,146 values across scenarios 1, 7, 8, 12, 16 and 25. This asks whether it moves under a GROSS perturbation of the same constant -- 3.14159265359 -> 3.2, a 1.9 percent change in the rotor area -- so that 'the gate cannot see this call site' is separated from 'the perturbation was too small to survive that consumer'.
